title: Supporting software for Observation-Specific Uncertainty Modeling for Latent-Variable Regression in High-Dimensional Analytical Data
description: This archive contains the code, data, analysis outputs, figures, and tables supporting the manuscript "Observation-Specific Uncertainty Modeling for Latent-Variable Regression in High-Dimensional Analytical Data". It includes the MATLAB analysis and figure-generation code, the Raman spectroscopy data and analysis outputs, and the derived outputs from the AqSolDB analysis. The third-party AqSolDB source dataset is not redistributed. It must be downloaded separately from the Harvard Dataverse record at https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/OVHAW8 and placed in the location specified in the repository README. The dataset remains subject to the licence and attribution requirements of its original creators.
